component.name: GridItem
component.script:
sub init() m.poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.glow = m.top.findNode("glow") m.focusIn = m.top.findNode("focusIn") m.focusOut = m.top.findNode("focusOut")
m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onContentChanged") m.top.observeField("isFocused", "onFocusChanged")
' Start from a known visual state m.top.scale = [1.0, 1.0] m.glow.opacity = 0.0 end sub
function pickPosterUrl(c as Object) as String if c = invalid then return ""
if c.fhdPosterUrl <> invalid and c.fhdPosterUrl <> "" then return c.fhdPosterUrl if c.hdPosterUrl <> invalid and c.hdPosterUrl <> "" then return c.hdPosterUrl if c.poster <> invalid and c.poster <> "" then return c.poster if c.thumbnail <> invalid and c.thumbnail <> "" then return c.thumbnail if c.sdPosterUrl <> invalid and c.sdPosterUrl <> "" then return c.sdPosterUrl
return "" end function
sub onContentChanged() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return
p = pickPosterUrl(c) if p <> "" then m.poster.uri = p else ' Local package fallback (prevents blank tiles) m.poster.uri = "pkg:/images/imagesfd_poster_fallback.png" end if end sub
sub onFocusChanged() if m.top.isFocused then if m.focusOut <> invalid then m.focusOut.control = "stop" if m.focusIn <> invalid then m.focusIn.control = "start" else m.top.scale = [1.04, 1.04] m.glow.opacity = 0.22 end if else if m.focusIn <> invalid then m.focusIn.control = "stop" if m.focusOut <> invalid then m.focusOut.control = "start" else m.top.scale = [1.0, 1.0] m.glow.opacity = 0.0 end if end if end sub
